name: HA Show Manager Service
description: Connects Kiosk Satellite to the ameriDroid HA Show manager service: LED strip as an RGB light with effects and voice patterns, microphone mute, mic array and system versions with update checks, the modular I2C sensors (detected automatically, published as Home Assistant sensors), and a shortcut to open the manager app.
author: ameriDroid

settings.title: Follow the hardware mic switch
settings.description: The slide switch on the HAT sets the microphone mute on the mic array itself. Turn off to control the mute only from here, Home Assistant or the manager app.

settings.title: Invert the hardware switch
settings.description: Swap which switch position means muted.

settings.title: Red strip while muted
settings.description: Turn the LED strip red whenever the microphone is muted.

settings.title: Mute sound
settings.description: Play a short whoosh when the microphone is muted (down) or unmuted (up).

settings.title: Mute sound volume
settings.description: How loud the mute whoosh is.

settings.title: Voice patterns
settings.description: Show listening, thinking and speaking patterns on the LED strip when the voice assistant is active.

settings.title: LEDs on the strip
settings.description: How many WS2812 LEDs are connected. The HA Show HAT has 8.

settings.title: Update channel
settings.description: Which release channel of the version feed to follow.

settings.title: Check for updates automatically
settings.description: Look for new mic array and system versions every few hours. Use the Check for updates action to look right now.
